"Minimum due" is the costliest button on your credit card. 💳

Up to 3.75% a month ≈ 45% a year.
Owe ₹1 lakh and pay only 5% a month: after 12 months you've paid ~₹56,000 and still owe ~₹86,000.
New purchases usually lose their interest-free period too.

Save this before your next card bill.
